summary: First iteration of StudyBook testing. Comprehensive backend + frontend testing executed. All 14 backend pytest cases passed (auth, questions CRUD/RBAC, test scheduling with live-window and negative marking, submit+result+leaderboard, final-test prerequisite lock, videos, referrals, leaderboard, plans, Stripe checkout via emergentintegrations, superadmin admin creation, announcements audience). Frontend Playwright script executed 12 UI checks — all passed: landing hero CTAs, admin login → /admin, admin dashboard stat tiles rendering real counts, admin add-question dialog flow saved a new question, manage tests page loads, student registration → /dashboard, QuestionBank renders + answer check flow, Leaderboard/Referrals/Pricing pages render (4 plan cards from backend).

minor.issue: Superadmin users receive no announcements because audience filter uses '{role}s' -> 'superadmins' which is not a valid audience literal (only 'all','students','admins').

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) — non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: extend AnnouncementCreate.audience to include 'superadmins' or change the filter in list_announcements to use role synonyms so superadmin can see admin-targeted announcements.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py sets cookies with SameSite=None+Secure which is correct for cross-site preview subdomain, good.
test_routes._parse_scheduled interprets scheduled_date + HH:MM as UTC — matches contract note; documented.
submit_test increments total_points by max(int(score), 0) — floors to int; acceptable but may under-award users when scores are fractional (e.g. 0.75 -> 0).
misc_routes.list_announcements audience filter mismatches 'superadmins' role synonym (see minor bug).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@studybook.com/Admin@123 · SuperAdmin: superadmin@studybook.com/Super@123. Students registered dynamically per test.
seed_data_creation: Tests created (and deleted) TEST_-prefixed questions, tests, plans, videos, announcements, and a temporary admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 22 request items and passes end-to-end. Stripe checkout is real (uses sk_test_emergent) and returns a live checkout URL + session_id, and payment_transactions row is created with status=initiated. Frontend Playwright covered admin login, dashboard tiles, question creation, student register, QB, Leaderboard, Referrals, Pricing. Only cosmetic/minor issue: superadmin announcements filter. No blocking issues.
